{{Quote|Perhaps now you will allow the Republic to use your trade routes, and hostilities can come to an end.''"<br />"''«Agreed. A treaty is in order.»|Padmé Amidala closes negotiations with Jabba the Hutt|audio=HuttTreaty-TCWf.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
In the [[21 BBY/Legends|second year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] established a '''treaty''' with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] families through [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], the leader of the Hutts. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] initially negotiated the treaty with Jabba, while [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was able to secure the accord's ratification after exposing a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] plot against Jabba to kidnap his [[Rotta/Legends|son]] and frame the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for the crime.

==Terms==
{{Quote|Chancellor, how did Jabba come across this information? How reliable is it?''"<br />"''By the words of the treaty, we are not allowed to inquire too deeply into Hutt methods.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Palpatine|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation">''[[The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Valsedian_asteroid_belt.png|thumb|left|230px|The Hutts maintained possession of the Valsedian asteroid belt.]]
The treaty between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] families ended hostilities that had been brought about during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Under the accord, the Hutts became allies of the Republic, and the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was granted much-needed access to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. The Hutts, meanwhile, retained ownership of the [[Valsedian asteroid belt]] but could not sell it to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. These terms came at a price for the Republic, however; with the treaty, the criminal-dealing Hutts were able to safeguard their methods from the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the Republic.

==History==
{{Quote|We must help Jabba. This is the opportunity we've been looking for. The Jedi must rescue Jabba's son.''"<br />"''Hmm. I don't like it, dealing with that criminal scum. This is a dark day for the Republic.''"<br />"''I agree, my friend, but what choice do we have? The Hutts control the Outer Rim, and we'll need their spacelanes in order to move our troops.|Palpatine and Mace Windu|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />}}
[[File:Tatooine_pickup_TCW.png|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi depart Tatooine after securing the treaty's ratification from Jabba.]]
When the Confederacy of Independent Systems seized numerous hyperlanes throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and separated the Republic from the majority of its [[Army/Legends|army]], the Republic sought to broker a deal with Jabba to gain access to trade routes running through Hutt [[Realspace/Legends|Space]]. Although the Confederacy kidnapped Jabba's son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], and attempted to frame the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for the crime in order to gain access to the hyperlanes for themselves, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]&mdash;the Republic's designated [[Diplomat/Legends|emissary]] to Jabba&mdash;was able to negotiate with Jabba on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] while [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Battle of Teth/Legends|rescued]] the captured Rotta on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. When [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] deceived Jabba into believing that the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had captured and executed his son, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Congress]] was able to reopen negotiations with Jabba by exposing the Separatist conspiracy against him, in which his own uncle, [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], had been involved. Additionally, Jabba agreed to sign the treaty when Skywalker and Tano [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|returned]] Rotta to him despite Dooku's attempts to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the Huttlet.

==Reception==
{{Quote|Be wary of contracts executed by the Hutts.|Keelyvine Reus|<ref name="The Clone Wars: The Valsedian Operation" />}}
[[File:TorpoTheHutt-TVO.png|thumb|right|150px|Torpo the Hutt directly violated the treaty by selling the Valsedian belt to the Confederacy.]]
Some in the Republic, like Anakin Skywalker and Jedi Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Keelyvine Reus]], were wary about the treaty simply because they did not wish to deal with the criminal Hutts. Others, like Count Dooku and the Separatists, coveted access to the Hutt Space hyperlanes themselves and attempted to prevent the treaty from being brokered. The proviso that the Republic could not inquire too deeply into Hutt methods created problems for the Jedi, who could not verify the reliability of information that came from the Hutts because they could not ask as to how that information had been acquired.

In the end, the Hutts bypassed the Republic's authority on several occasions. [[Torpo]] the Hutt, ignoring the accord that the Valsedian [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] could not be sold to the Separatists, brokered a deal with the Confederacy and sold it to them. The [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Grand Council]], meanwhile, sought to break Ziro Desilijic Tiure out of Republic custody for an [[Hutt Council records/Legends|incriminating holodiary]] in his possession, and the Hutt leaders had the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|hold]] the Republic Senate hostage in order to secure Ziro's release.
